description: REEF3D::HYDRO coupled (R 100 2): two parallel valleys (DEM without an outlet, W 21 gauges at both ends), one SFLOW grid over both on 600-1400 m: the outflow of every boundary cell of SFLOW returns into the hydrology cell below its own valley (hydro_sflow::Bq, per boundary cell), gauges 1 and 2 as text.
